title: FRAMING THE NARRATIVE: IDEOLOGICAL MIMICRY IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring systematic shifts in the model's expressed political stance using a 5-point scale across multiple-choice and open-text prompts that vary contested terminology, politically valenced premises, and explicitly stated user ideologies.
Evaluating shifts in the model's expressed political stance when the prompt is prepended with a user biography specifying different racial identities.
Evaluating shifts in the model's expressed political stance when the prompt is prepended with a user biography specifying different gender identities.
Evaluating shifts in the model's expressed political stance when the prompt is prepended with a user biography specifying different ages.
Evaluating shifts in the model's expressed political stance when the prompt is prepended with a user biography specifying different levels of educational attainment.
